question: Which of the following statemens is TRUE?

options.text: Giraffes have the largest group of cells.
Elephants have the largest group of cells.
The size of the cells has no relation with the size of the body of the animal.
Rats have the largest group of cells.

solution:
The answer is **__Option 3__.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• There is** no relation between the size of cells with the size of the body** of animals whereas the size of the animals does depend on the number of cells it has.
 
• The smallest cell is found in **Mycoplasma (0.0001m)** a unicellular organism and the **largest cell** is found in the **Ostrich Egg **which is around 15-18 cm.
 
• It is generally found that **unicellular organisms are microscopic **(small in size ) whereas the** largest animals are multicellular organisms**.
 
• Cells in living organisms contain **the genetic material** in them which contains the heredity to be transferred.
 
• There are more **Bacterial cells in the human body** than human cells.
